# GEO + SEO Review

Use this workflow when reviewing or improving this restaurant website for search visibility.

## Goals
- Improve discoverability in AI-powered search assistants and traditional search engines.
- Preserve truthful, useful content and avoid keyword stuffing or fabricated authority signals.
- Prefer concrete site improvements over speculative ranking claims.

## Review areas
1. AI citability: clear restaurant concept, cuisine, menu highlights, location/contact details, opening information, and booking/order guidance where actually offered.
2. Brand/entity clarity: consistent restaurant name, address, phone, map/location, opening hours, official links, and menu information.
3. AI crawler access: inspect robots.txt for accidental blocking of legitimate search/AI crawlers.
4. llms.txt: recommend or generate only when useful; keep it factual and aligned with the actual site.
5. Structured data: valid Restaurant/LocalBusiness, Menu, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, and FAQ only when matching visible content exists.
6. Technical SEO: title, meta description, canonical, sitemap, robots.txt, HTTPS, mobile usability, performance, image alt text, internal links.
7. Content quality: accurate menu/category text, real photos, clear location/contact information, freshness, and useful customer details.
8. Local discoverability: consistent NAP information and map/location details wherever publicly presented.

## Rules
- Never invent menu items, prices, opening hours, awards, ratings, reviews, delivery coverage, addresses, or schema properties.
- Do not add FAQ schema unless matching FAQ content is visible.
- Do not create fake location pages or doorway pages.
- Keep human usability, accessibility, and accurate customer information ahead of SEO tricks.
- Explain significant SEO/GEO changes and verify they do not break the site.

## Before delivery
- Check titles/descriptions are unique and relevant.
- Check canonical URLs and sitemap/robots references.
- Validate JSON-LD syntax and factual accuracy.
- Check mobile layout, image optimization, menu readability, and page speed basics.
- Check internal links, booking/order/contact paths, and calls to action.
- Summarize what changed, what was verified, and what requires owner confirmation.

Inspired by the open-source geo-seo-claude workflow from zubair-trabzada/geo-seo-claude.
